reason: SessionsPage now resolves a ?session= link that is not in the open project's conversation list: it reads GET chat-sessions/{id} (new ApiClient.getChatSession), replaces the URL with the owning project's workbench (the canonical project route selects it), and shows ConversationLinkNotice states (opening, not found, refused, unknown project, archived with Restore project, failed with Try again) instead of a blank chat. It also detaches a conversation left open when the URL moves to an unresolvable link, skips `session` on the Terminal view (terminal ids), and opens the chat for a view-less conversation link loaded fresh. Selected: the classifier and notice unit tests (conversationLink.test.ts, ConversationLinkNotice.test.tsx); the App-level suites that render SessionsPage through routing and deep links (App.test.tsx, App.projectBoundary.test.tsx, App.sendConsent.test.tsx, App.subagentChoice.test.tsx, chatDraftNavigation.test.tsx) and client.test.ts for the new client method; tests/test_playwright_impact.py because ui/playwright-impact.json gains the conversation-deep-link rule and areas. Playwright: entry:assistant/{desktop,mobile-chromium,mobile-webkit} as required for any SessionsPage change (78+73+72 tests, each including the new mocked journey); area:conversation-deep-link runs the new mocked journey on desktop, compact and the 320/390/430 Chromium and WebKit phone projects (8); area:conversation-deep-link-core runs the new real-Core LAN journey on assistant-real-desktop, -chromium-390 and -webkit-390 (3). Counts from vitest runs, pytest collection and playwright --list.
exclusions: No Python product tests: Core is unchanged (the generic read-only GET /api/v1/chat-sessions/{id} already exists). No native tests: no Rust or desktop-shell change. Other SessionsPage-matched areas (conversation-progress, provider-reasoning, provider-thinking, chat-edit-in-place, research-context-core) are excluded: the change only adds link resolution before a conversation is selected and does not touch streaming, reasoning, editing or research context; the assistant entries cover the rest of the page. The new real-Core journey also passed locally on assistant-real-compact and the 320/430 phone projects; CI keeps 3 of the 8 to bound real-Core cost. No full suite.
